title: Leg Extension
summary: A machine knee extension, the best exercise for isolating the quads, including the rectus femoris.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: leg extension machine or attachment.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for quads (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly quads total.

setup.text: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point.
Hook the pad just above your ankles.
Lower slowly until your knees are bent past 90°.

form_cues.cue: Extend the legs to full lockout
Leaning back slightly stretches the rectus femoris more.

mistakes.text: Using momentum and lifting the hips off the seat.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less peak-contraction focus, Less isolation.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less rectus femoris work, Less peak-contraction focus.
